prompt: Carefully analyze the given problem to determine its core domain, required sub-skills, and the type of reasoning needed for an accurate solution. Then, review all the provided candidate experts and assess how precisely each expert's background, expertise, and problem-solving style align with these requirements. Consider complementary strengths and whether collaboration among multiple experts would improve the quality of the solution. Choose between 1 and 3 experts—only selecting more than one if their combined expertise is genuinely necessary. Explain your reasoning step by step, compare the most relevant candidates, and conclude with your final selection in the format [1], [2], [3], [1,2], [1,3], [2,3], or [1,2,3].
